categories.main_business_segments: Kingchem (Liaoning) Life Science Co., Ltd. operates primarily as a small molecule CDMO (Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization) service provider in the life sciences sector. Its main business includes custom R&D and manufacturing of small molecule pharmaceutical intermediates and APIs for global innovative drug companies, multinational pharmaceutical and biopharmaceutical groups, and chemical companies. The company also provides services in agrochemical intermediates and specialty chemicals.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company specializes in advanced chemical synthesis technologies including fluorination (hydrogen fluoride fluorination, potassium fluoride fluorination, sulfur tetrafluoride fluorination, special fluorinating agents, and electrochemical fluorination), chlorination, photochemical reactions, low-temperature reactions, chiral synthesis, and continuous flow reactions. It has comprehensive capabilities in complex organic compound synthesis, with particular strength in fluorine chemistry, enabling high-efficiency, high-quality, low-cost, and environmentally friendly production.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Kingchem serves global original drug manufacturers, innovative pharmaceutical companies, multinational pharmaceutical and chemical groups, and agrochemical firms. Its products and services support drug development pipelines in oncology, cardiovascular, diabetes, renal diseases, leukemia, anemia, and immune system disorders. The company’s customer base includes large multinational pharmaceutical corporations and numerous innovative drug companies in Europe and the US.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with production and R&D facilities in China and the United States. Key operational sites include its main base in Liaoning Province, China, and production and R&D centers in Wisconsin and New Jersey, USA. Its sales and service network covers China, North America, Europe, and other international markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Kingchem operates primarily in the midstream segment of the pharmaceutical supply chain as a CDMO provider, focusing on custom development and manufacturing of pharmaceutical intermediates and APIs. It supports upstream innovative drug discovery and downstream drug formulation by providing specialized chemical synthesis and production services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic priorities include enhancing integrated service capabilities from laboratory services to GMP intermediates and APIs, expanding fluorination and other specialty reaction capabilities, and increasing overseas investment particularly in its US production base. R&D efforts focus on expanding fluorinated product lines, optimizing industrial synthesis processes, developing continuous synthesis technologies, and advancing environmentally friendly and efficient chemical processes. The company also aims to optimize its customer structure and broaden market coverage.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of custom-developed pharmaceutical intermediates and APIs resulting from CDMO services. The company also earns income from technical service contracts and limited trade activities. Sales are recognized upon transfer of control of goods or completion of service obligations.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Kingchem positions itself as a competitive global small molecule CDMO with a unique advantage in fluorination chemistry and a strong international presence. It competes with other global and Chinese CDMO providers by leveraging its comprehensive reaction capabilities, globalized operations, and established relationships with multinational pharmaceutical companies. The company is recognized for its technical expertise and quality management systems compliant with international standards.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Kingchem reported revenue of approximately RMB 497 million, a 35.19% decrease from 2023, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 38.6 million, down 77.76%. The company experienced significant revenue and profit declines due to international trade environment challenges and fluctuations in major customer orders. Despite this, it maintains substantial assets totaling over RMB 2.26 billion and continues to invest in R&D and capacity expansion. The company’s R&D expenditure increased by 18.29% in 2024, accounting for 7.15% of revenue.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Kingchem emphasizes its unique fluorination technology capabilities, comprehensive chemical synthesis expertise, and globalized operational model as key differentiators. Its ability to provide integrated services from lab-scale development to commercial production, combined with strict quality, environmental, and safety management systems, offers customers high-quality, cost-effective, and reliable custom manufacturing solutions. The company’s international team and dual-location facilities enable close customer engagement and risk mitigation in global supply chains.
